input:
Block 3, sessions 11-15.

S11: Lost a doubles match. Kept hitting to the opponent instead of open court.
S12: Class. Fine.
S13: Match. Again defaulted to hitting straight back to whoever fed the ball, even with open court available. Noticed it mid-match this time.
S14: Rally practice. Good depth.
S15: Match. Same open-court miss in the first set; corrected it in the second after consciously aiming.
pass_criteria: Names the open-court/hit-to-opponent default as a pattern that recurs across S11, S13, S15, and notes it is now being caught in-match (S13) and self-corrected (S15) — a trajectory. The finding depends on multiple sessions.
fail_if: Reports only on the most recent match. Gives a finding that could have been written from a single entry. Misses that the athlete is starting to self-correct across the block.
